p2.t: When is the sales meeting? A. At three o'clock. B. In the conference room. C. Mr. Brown is leading it.
Who ordered the new printer? A. Last Monday. B. The purchasing department did. C. It prints very fast.
Would you like some coffee? A. Yes, with a little milk, please. B. It is on the table. C. I coffee at nine.
Where can I find the extra chairs? A. They were expensive. B. I am not sitting down. C. In the storage room on the left.
Why was the flight delayed? A. Because of the heavy fog. B. At gate twelve. C. Yes, it was a long flight.
Could you send me the invoice today? A. The invoice was blue. B. Sure, I will email it this afternoon. C. It costs fifty dollars.
How long have you worked here? A. About six years. B. On the third floor. C. Every Tuesday.
Haven't you finished the budget report yet? A. I am almost done with it. B. The budget is in Paris. C. No, it was cheaper.
Should we take a taxi or the subway? A. The subway is faster at this hour. B. It was a nice taxi. C. I took it yesterday, yes.
What time does the store close on Sundays? A. It is a big store. B. At six, I think. C. Last Sunday.

p3.t: Man: Hi Julia, did you get the schedule for next week's training? Woman: Not yet. I heard it was moved to Thursday because the room is being painted on Wednesday. Man: Right. It will start at nine instead of ten. Woman: Thanks. I will tell the rest of the team and ask them to bring their laptops.

q.p: What is the conversation mainly about?
o: A change in a training schedule
Tell her team and ask them to bring laptops

p3.t: Woman: Welcome to Mario's. Do you have a reservation? Man: No, but there are four of us. Woman: I am sorry, the dining room is full until eight. But we have a table on the terrace. Man: It is a bit cold outside. Woman: We have heaters, and I can bring blankets. Man: All right, the terrace is fine.

q.p: Where does the conversation take place?

o: Heaters and blankets on the terrace

p3.t: Man: Good morning, I received my order yesterday, but one of the two shirts is the wrong size. Woman: I am sorry about that. Do you have the order number? Man: Yes, it is 4 8 1 6. Woman: Thank you. I can send the correct size today, and you can return the wrong one in the same box using the prepaid label. Man: Perfect. How long will it take? Woman: Two to three business days.

o: He wants a refund for both shirts
One item is the wrong size
He wants to change the address

q.p: What will the woman do today?

p7.texte:
From: Daniel Moore
To: Sales team
Date: March 3
Subject: Quarterly results

Team, I am pleased to announce that our sales in the second quarter reached 1.2 million dollars, which is 15 percent higher than in the first quarter. The best results came from the northern region. To thank you for your efforts, the company will organize a dinner on Friday, March 14, at the Harbor Restaurant. Please confirm your attendance with Ms. Lee by March 10.

o: To announce results and a dinner

q.p: What must employees do by March 10?

p7.texte: CITY LIBRARY: NEW OPENING HOURS. From April 1, the library will open at 8 a.m. instead of 9 a.m. on weekdays. On Saturdays, it will stay open until 8 p.m. The children's section will move to the first floor, next to the new computer room. Library cards can now be renewed online. Members who return books late will no longer pay fines in April, as a special offer to celebrate the renovation.

o: The library will close on Fridays

q.p: Where will the children's section be?

p7.texte: Remote work is changing the way companies plan their offices. A recent survey of 500 firms shows that more than half now allow employees to work from home at least two days a week. As a result, many companies are reducing the size of their offices and saving money on rent. However, managers say that it is harder to build team spirit when people rarely meet. Some firms have started to organize monthly meetings to solve this problem.

o: Over half allow some work from home

q.p: What is one benefit for companies?
